title: Reward Modeling Rlhf
motto: Humans cannot write a reward function for "good assistant response," but they can compare two responses and pick the better one. Fit a reward model to those comparisons, then RL the language model against it. Christiano 2017. InstructGPT 2022. The recipe that turned GPT-3 into ChatGPT. In 2026 it is mostly being replaced by DPO — but the mental model stays.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You trained a language model on the next-token-prediction objective. It writes grammatical English. It also lies, rambles, and refuses to refuse. You cannot fix this with more pretraining — web text is the problem, not the cure.

You want a *scalar reward* that says "response A is better than response B for instruction X." Writing that reward function by hand is impossible. "Helpfulness" is not a closed-form expression over tokens. But humans can compare two outputs and mark a preference. That is cheap to collect at scale.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Reward models score completions for RLHF preference learning.
